description: POST /v1/merchants/me/sessions/:id/retry-forwarder - re-runs settlement for a session in status failed whose deposit address still holds the funds. Nothing retries a failed session by itself. Answers 202 once the run has started; follow the outcome with sessions_get: the session leaves failed while settlement runs and ends completed, or returns to failed. 400: the session is not failed, no funded deposit address remains (already forwarded or never received), or it needs manual recovery - contact support. 409: a retry is already running. 503: on-chain state could not be read and nothing changed, so retry later. Uses the cached sk_* key of the selected mode, else a fresh JWT.
name: sessions_retry_forwarder
title: Retry settlement of a failed session
